acceptanceCriteria: Stress test with >=8 concurrent slot writers shows no capacity overrun or leak, retained as evidence.
Wait/notify and claim-time acquisition each either specified or explicitly declined with rationale.
body: Found by lane V1-1550 (PR beamfall/corvint#1019, head 19f66b4e4, GitHub #1008) on 2026-10-17. Non-goals of V1-1550 retained as follow-ups: push/wait notification instead of polling for a slot; acquiring slots at claim or supervised-run time; a stress test of concurrent slot writers (NOT_RUN in the lane).
title: Capacity slots follow-ups: wait/notify instead of polling, acquire at claim time, concurrent-writer stress test
